blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. JV Ejercito is pushing for an increase in the Personnel Economic Relief Allowance (PERA) for government employees from P2,000 to P5,000 per month, according to a statement issued by his office on Monday. The hike in the allowance —last adjusted in 2009 through Joint Resolution No. 4 issued by both chambers of Congress — should serve as an economic safety net for more than three million public servants. Ejercito hoped to raise the allowance through his Senate Bill No. 2540, or the proposed “PERA Adjustment Act,” a response to calls from teachers and government workers’ groups, including […]...
